regions.name: the Hearth Fields
regions.note: The fields around home.

regions.name: the Sacred Valley
regions.note: Six river tiles from home’s east side down to Mirror Lake.

regions.name: Stonebrake
regions.note: Hills just north-east of home, round the Greyback crag; the copper hills.

regions.name: the Old Wood
regions.note: Starts at home’s south side and runs out to the deep forest; slow to finish.

regions.name: the Great Weald
regions.note: Meadows round Bright Mere.

regions.name: Tallow Fen
regions.note: Reed beds on Mirror Lake’s shore.

regions.name: the Old Crown
regions.note: Hills with a crag at their crown, south-west of home.

regions.name: Thornridge
regions.note: The old watchtower on the Stream above home.

regions.name: Mirror Lake
regions.note: Where every river meets.

regions.name: Barrowdown
regions.note: Old barrows on the downs; the Red Host’s forward camp.

regions.name: the Upper Valley
regions.note: The Stream’s valley below the Springs; the road to Psalter Pass.

regions.name: Compline Wood
regions.note: Holds the Rift.

regions.name: Hushbrook Vale
regions.note: The south-west’s river valley.

regions.name: the Springs
regions.note: Where the Stream rises.

regions.name: Cankerwood
regions.note: Round the Black Tor.

regions.name: Bloodford
regions.note: The north-east’s river valley, where the Red Water is forded.

regions.name: Wanmoor
regions.note: Fen round the Pale Mere.

regions.name: Glasswold
regions.note: Downs round Glass Mere.

regions.name: the Brittle Peaks
regions.note: Rock gone brittle where the Rot reached it.

regions.name: Bellreach
regions.note: The northern range, crossed by Psalter Pass.

regions.name: Lastlight
regions.note: The lamplighters’ fells; the haven.

regions.name: Cantor’s Peak
regions.note: Above Bell Tarn.

regions.name: Cinderwood
regions.note: Where the Red Water rises.

regions.name: the Rotmouth
regions.note: The Sallow’s mouth, where the Rot comes in.

regions.name: the Seam
regions.note: Mountains where the world wears thin; Lastlight on its shoulder.

regions.name: Ironhold
regions.note: The dwarves’ hold in the north-east corner.

regions.name: Farthest
regions.note: The last region: the hole in the world.

regions.name: the High Cloister
regions.note: The Choir’s seat.

regions.name: the Abbey Deep
regions.note: Sea over the Sunk Abbey.
